comment: Pinned libmpv artifacts vendored by scripts/fetch-libmpv.mjs. `url` is always one of OUR releases (a build release of outcast1000/viboplr-libmpv, or this repo's 'vendor-libmpv' prerelease for builds published before that repo existed) — never an upstream link (shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake deletes builds after ~30 days, which broke the v1.0.94 Windows build when the pinned one vanished). Both platforms pin OUR OWN trimmed, self-contained build: outcast1000/viboplr-libmpv builds it from pinned sources in its manual build-libmpv workflow, which runs THIS repo's real-libmpv engine tests on both platforms and publishes the archive plus its build-info JSON (`upstream`) as a release named after the build (`build`; the engine-component packager uses it for its zip name). Don't edit entries by hand: `npm run libmpv:adopt [-- <tag>]` re-pins every field from the release, vendors it and republishes the engine component; then re-test playback on both platforms before committing. `source` is a description — a line written by hand survives an adopt of the same bytes.

macos-aarch64.source: self-built: outcast1000/viboplr-libmpv (mpv master 9028187538 2026-11-05 + coreaudio format-sync mixability patch (mpv #18772), trimmed, FFmpeg 9.0.2 static, LuaJIT, GPL)
